acquisition_method: Data-dependent acquisition mode was used to trigger precursor isolation and sequencing.
alkylation_concentration: Five microliters of IAA solution (30 mM in 50 mM ABC) was dispensed to alkylate sulfhydryl groups by incubating the vials in the dark for 30 min at room temperature.
alkylation_reagent: Iodoacetamide (IAA) was purchased from Thermo Scientific (St. Louis, MO, USA) and freshly prepared in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer each day before use.
cleavage_agent: Trypsin (MS grade) and Lys-C (MS grade) were products of Promega (Madison, WI, USA).
collision_energy: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
fragmentation_method: fragmented by high energy dissociation with a collision energy of 28%.
instrument: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid MS (ThermoFisher) was employed for all data collection.
ionization_type: leading to enhanced efficiencies at the electrospray ionization (ESI) source.
labeling: inferred: LFQ calculations were performed separately in each parameter group containing similar cell loading.
mass_analyzer: MS/MS scans were performed in the Orbitrap.
ptm: N-terminal protein acetylation, methionine oxidation, Carbamidomethylation of cysteine
N-terminal protein acetylation and methionine oxidation were selected as variable modifications. Carbamidomethylation of cysteine residues was set as a fixed modification.
reduction_concentration: 100 nL of RapiGest solution (0.1% in 50 mM ABC) containing 5 mM DTT was added.
reduction_reagent: DTT and iodoacetamide (IAA) were purchased from Thermo Scientific (St. Louis, MO, USA) and freshly prepared in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate buffer each day before use.

_hallucination_flags.evidence: 100 nL of RapiGest solution (0.1% in 50 mM ABC) containing 5 mM DTT was added.
